repository.checks: All existing Epic E validators/tests plus aggregate schemas, exact references, plan governance and adversarial tests
repository.success: Architecture and bounded plan preparation valid; blocked facts remain visible

admin.checks: Fresh complete read audit, definitions, native fields, exact target existence, reference approvals and snapshot-to-snapshot drift
admin.success: Selected read-only scope reconciled; never mutation authorization

migration.checks: Per-domain approved inputs, hashes, before/rollback coverage, definitions, exact targets and domain-specific GO
migration.success: Plan preparation reported separately from execution preconditions

exitCodes.0: Selected gate passed with explicit domain states

diagnostics.productCsv: Run the existing validator unchanged; preserve individual image-alt/price findings. Blocking for applicable release scope, not a reason to falsify data.
diagnostics.optionalBarcodes: Absence is allowed under current governed consumer policy; report duplicates and invalid claims separately.
diagnostics.shippingWeight: Positive observed native weight is not a newly approved correction; report all missing native weights.
diagnostics.launchFixtures: Run ownership checks after the authorized filename correction; missing ownership is a finalization finding.

requires: applicable migrations and verified after snapshots
